caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted head resembling that of a lion or similar feline, shown isolated against a plain, light beige background. The object has a grayish-brown color with varying shades, providing a sense of texture and volume. The head is depicted with prominent, rounded ears on either side, closed or half-closed almond-shaped eyes, a broad nose, and defined, downward-curving lips. The surface of the sculpture is marked by ridges and shallow lines, particularly on the forehead and around the eyes and muzzle, giving the appearance of fur or skin folds. The overall form is three-dimensional, with shading used to indicate depth and curvature, and there are no other objects or elements present in the composition.
title: Lion's Head (one of pair)
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
